Glass Plumbing Services saved the day! When my wife's DIY bidet installation turned disastrous with a broken toilet outlet turned into a snapped water main without being able to get the water shut off. Literally text book case of nightmarish series of unfortunate events! It became incredibly stressful after calling several services to have them come out and none of them could come out quickly..... Glass Plumbing had the swift response and expert repairs. I can't tell you other than saying Kody was a lifesaver. As soon as he got here, he found the city water main and turned that off stopping the water leak inside. Professional, reliable, and efficient, turned a plumbing nightmare into a manageable situation. Highly recommend their services for any plumbing needs! 10/10 will always use this service and refer friends and family. I highly recommend this commendable expert level service. I uploaded pictures of the water main to the house that broke - and the replacement , the toilet valve that broke and the replacement valve + line, and the room that got flooded.
